lines.3: 「No way. We don't need some girl who looks that busty.」
lines.5: 「Fukahire may be trash, but he's still a second-year. I'm going to teach her how to treat her elders.」
lines.6: 「In plain terms, I'll teach her a lesson.」
lines.8: 「If it turns into a fight, we stop them.」
lines.16: 「It's me! The cute waitress from Curry House Oasis!」
lines.19: 「Watch how you talk to me. I'm a second-year.」
lines.20: 「Now, I hate rigid hierarchies, okay? But I still think a minimum level of respect for your seniors is essential if you want to function in society.」
lines.21: 「And in your case, I think you're still seriously lacking in that area.」
lines.22: 「I'm only worried about you as your senior, you understand.」
lines.24: 「So I'll straighten out that stagnant, rotten spirit of yours. For starters, go buy me a juice at the college cafeter--」
